text:
Monitoring Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on streaming-gateway (us-west-2) starting 04:32 UTC. 5xx=7.8% (baseline ~0.4%). Several client streams report disconnects/early EOF. Paging @infra-oncall

infra-oncall: I'm on it. Severity P1 for now. Can someone confirm if this correlates with the 03:50 deploy? Tagging runtime.

Alice K: I see increased downstream 502s from the runtime pool and a spike in connection resets at the gateway. Also seeing higher memory and high garbage collection on runtime pods.

Ben R (Runtime Team): Confirmed. Around 03:48 we had a big KV cache eviction wave on the model-inference nodes after recent prefix-cache changes. Backlog of batching requests grew, some workers hit oom_kill.

Carol L: Support: multiple customers reported streaming sessions aborted. Tickets: #14321, #14322, #14325. Most report client-side cancellation immediately followed by server-side 5xx. Customers affected include AcmeChat, Formsly.

Dave M: Quick mitigation plan: 1) reduce load on affected nodes by adjusting LB weights, 2) rollback the prefix-cache TTL change, 3) bump gateway upstream timeout to 90s, 4) temporarily disable streaming chunked flush optimization. I'll run steps 1 & 3 now.

Runtime Team: Repro snippet for investigation:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://gw.us-west-2.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-medium" 
# observed error in gw logs:
[stream-gw] 2026-03-14T04:35:12Z ERROR chunked write failed: write tcp 10.0.0.5:443->10.1.2.3:51784: connection reset by peer
```

Ben R: Also noticed many client cancellations that weren't propagating; server kept KV handles open causing memory pressure. Suggest a guard to drop stale KV references after 5s of client disconnect.

infra-oncall: Applying LB weight change to divert ~40% traffic to other regions/nodes and increasing gateway timeout. Rolling update on gateway to disable chunked flush in progress.

Alice K: Patch rolled out to gateway (rollback flush optim). LB weights adjusted. Runtime nodes: scaling extra replicas and reverting prefix-cache TTL. Monitoring: 5xx down from 7.8% -> 1.8% in the last 6m. Latency slightly up but error rate improving.

Support Bot: Noted mitigations in customer tickets. Sent message to AcmeChat and Formsly with ETA and temporary workaround: retry with exponential backoff, or use non-stream endpoint for long-running jobs.

Dave M: For the immediate hotfix I ran:
```
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/gateway STREAM_CHUNKED_FLUSH=false && 
kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway -n prod
# and
kubectl patch svc/gw --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/annotations/lb-weight","value":"60"}]'
```
Changes applied at 04:38 UTC.

Runtime Team: We're adding a quick guard to free KV entries on client disconnect and adding backpressure to batching queue. Will open PR and fast-track to canary.

Carol L: Customer impact update: AcmeChat saw ~12% of in-flight streams fail before mitigation; now reduced to ~2%. They're happy with the progress but want RCA.

infra-oncall: Current status: mitigation in place, error rate trending down. Forming incident ticket INC-2026-042: streaming-gateway-5xx-kv-pressure. Assigning to Runtime Team for RCA and postmortem.

Alice K: Notes for postmortem: correlate deploy at 03:48 with prefix-cache TTL change, client cancel handling regression, and gateway chunked flush behavior. Need better canary/pressure tests for streaming paths.

Support Bot: Customers notified, follow-ups scheduled.

infra-oncall: Handing off to next oncall @Runtime Team for continued monitoring and RCA. Please include mitigation timeline and customer impact summary. :thumbsup:

Runtime Team: Acknowledged. We'll continue to monitor and push the KV-disconnect guard in the canary batch and report back within 2 hours.

Alice K: Thanks everyone — logging this thread into INC-2026-042 and adding the metric dashboards used to the ticket.

Ben R: Added a few logs to the PR to capture client disconnect cause codes.

infra-oncall: Closing live mitigation phase. If error rate creeps back above 2% we re-open. All set for handoff at 06:00 UTC.

Alice K: Signed off.

Support Bot: Closing customer-facing updates for now.
